verdict.rationale: Jina Reader explicitly supports POSTing PDFs and MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) files directly via the `file` body field without needing to host them, and the self-hosted image bundles LibreOffice to process these office formats. Community evidence shows some auth/404 issues but none specifically contradict document-extraction functionality. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of extraction quality/fidelity across all four file types and no detail on limits (file size, complex formatting).
